title: DIRECTIVE: DEEP HORIZON - OCT 1983
content:
STATION ECHO-7 STATUS: Commissioned for deep seismic acoustic telemetry.

Primary mandate: listen to low-frequency anomalous harmonic pulses emanating from borehole shaft 9.
Strict quarantine protocol in effect. All surface elevators locked until review.

title: INCIDENT LOG: SUB-LEVEL BREACH
content:
The array picked up a modulated waveform at 84.7 kHz. It is NOT seismic.

Five minutes after lock, the communications lab terminal began printing unsolicited transmissions. Dr. Thorne refused to cut the receiver power. He claims the signal is "responding to our heartbeats".
Emergency circuit breaker tripped in the Airlock.

title: DR. THORNE'S FIELD SCRAP
content:
We assumed the transmission was traveling downward from an orbital satellite or deep space.

God help us. The telemetry antennas are pointing 4,000 meters STRAIGHT DOWN into the permafrost core.
The carrier wave is resonant at 84.7 kHz with 65% harmonic modulation.
The isolation vault lock sequence is tied to the station coordinates: Core [5], Array [7], Bio-Pass [2], Vault [9].

title: DECODED TRANSMISSION ECHO
content:
>>> CARRIER SYNCHRONIZED <<<
TRANS-ACOUSTIC SIGNATURE: BIOLOGICAL / METALLIC HYBRID.

"WE DO NOT COME FROM ABOVE. WE HAVE BEEN ASLEEP UNDER YOUR CONTINENT FOR THREE HUNDRED MILLION YEARS. YOUR DRILL AWAKENED THE NERVE ENDINGS."

EMERGENCY OVERRIDE CODE FOR SUB-VAULT 9 CONFIRMED: 5 - 7 - 2 - 9.

title: BLACK BOX TRANSMISSION: VAULT INTERIOR
content:
If someone from the surface is listening to this... do not send rescue teams.

The object in Vault 9 is not a meteor or inactive artifact. It is a dormant neural node of a planetary organism. The radio signals we broadcast into space for decades acted like an irritant... like an alarm bell.

It has connected to our communication relay. It is using our own antennas to broadcast outside... It is calling the rest of them.
